question: Will an order receive a 1-2 star review?

target.name: is_low_review
target.grain: one row per order_id, one review per order (earliest kept)

cohort: reviewed orders with at least one line item, delivered or not; purchase months 2016-09 to 2018-08 (78,085 orders)

prediction_point.name: survey trigger T
prediction_point.rationale: Olist emails the review survey when the order is delivered or the estimated date passes; every delivery feature is evaluated as of T
prediction_point.flag: config/feature_roles.csv column T_dependent; clf_config.features_at_T(); audit notebook Section 3

stakeholder.decision: rank orders at T by low-review risk and route the top of the list to proactive outreach; aggregate by seller for quality reviews

protocol.design: Zaghloul, Barakat & Rezk (2024), J. Retailing and Consumer Services 79:103865 - stratified 67/33 train+validation / test on is_low_review - with a validation set added: stratified 80/20 train / validation of the 67% (overall ~54 / 13 / 33)
protocol.manifest: data/split_manifest.csv (order_id -> split; git-ignored, rebuilt deterministically by data_preparation_audit)

roles.train: fit pipelines; 5-fold stratified shuffled CV for hyperparameters and OOF probabilities
roles.validation: baselines vs ladder, CatBoost early stopping, F1 threshold, stacking / ensemble retention rule

protocol.history_features: outcome events (delivery, review) aggregated from training rows only; orders placed counted over all rows

chronological_reference.use: drift figure and the robustness check in docs/current_progress.md only

C_ensemble: mean / convex / logistic stack on matured OOF probabilities (ensemble_comparison)

class_imbalance.strategy: stratified split keeps the positive rate equal across train / validation / test; class weights in every model; threshold tuned on validation to maximise F1 then frozen
class_imbalance.resampling: RandomOverSampler, SMOTE and ADASYN compared with none and class weights for all four models in sampling_comparison (Zaghloul et al. 2024 Experiment 4); resampling inside imblearn pipelines on training rows only
class_imbalance.evidence: class-balance study in ensemble_comparison; full grid in outputs/tables/sampling_comparison.csv

metrics.primary: PR-AUC (average precision) on the test window, threshold-free
secondary: precision / recall / F1 at frozen threshold
baselines: rule: not delivered by T implies low review
metrics.selection: validation PR-AUC; ensemble retained only if >= 1% relative gain over best single model

success_criteria.operating_point: recall >= 0.60 with precision >= 0.35 at the frozen threshold (set 6 Oct, before modelling)

test_scored: once per final model inside each notebook

mapping.wd_actual_delivery_time: wd_actual_delivery_time (same name; evaluated as of T, NaN if not delivered by T)
mapping.wd_delivery_time_delta: wd_delivery_time_delta (same name; working days delivered - promised, as of T)

interpretability.shap: TreeExplainer on the final forest (validation sample), grouped by original feature; CatBoost SHAP and exact linear SHAP as cross-checks; sampling_comparison
